name: Èṣù / Eshu (Yoruba)

domain_history.domain: messenger/intermediary between Olódùmarè, the other Òrìṣà, and humanity; enforcer of divine law
mischaracterized as "Satan"/"the Devil" in 19th-century missionary translation

notes: The trickster reputation is explained in devotional/academic-adjacent sources as pedagogical (using irony/paradox to push humans toward wisdom and correct ritual conduct) rather than malevolent — flagged as interpretive gloss, not traced to a single named peer-reviewed anthropologist at HIGH confidence.
